mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today is balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 77 degrees, though it feels closer to 82 out there with a waxing crescent moon in the sky.

The Verona Senior Center is currently seeking volunteers to assist with various programs. They are looking for people who can commit to at least two shifts a month, and they provide all the necessary training to maintain privacy and dignity for our seniors.

We have a busy schedule today with live music at both Bailey is Run and Lake Lou-ee, alongside a free Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, tomorrow features the annual User Group Meeting at Epic Systems and yoga sessions at Insight Wellness.
In our police report for the week, on August 6th, an officer observed a vehicle being operated erratically, which resulted in the driver being arrested for a fourth offence O W I.
Today is the perfect day for a scoop of Mint Cookie. Since the store is currently closed, keep in mind they open their doors at 10 AM for you to grab a treat.
